score_notes.christology: RPCNA subscribes to the Westminster Standards — orthodox Trinitarian Christology.

score_notes.leadership: Plural session of elders under the Presbytery.
score_notes.soteriology: Reformed/Calvinistic — sola fide, sola gratia, doctrines of grace.
score_notes.cultural: RPCNA is a small covenanter body with strong social testimony against unjust public structures; no DEI/CRT framework.
score_notes.preaching: Expository lectio continua preaching typical of Reformed presbyterianism.
score_notes.mission: Cross-cultural missions through the RP Global Missions board.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Shepherding by elders; family-integrated catechesis (Shorter Catechism).
score_notes.denominational: Reformed Presbyterian Church of North America — Westminster Standards + RPCNA Testimony; distinctive practice of exclusive a cappella psalmody in worship.
